filer_name.rationale: Blueprint references the filer's name from page 1 header, but candidates only contain shareholder name fields (ShareholderPersonNm, BusinessNameLine1Txt) which are distinct from the top-of-page filer name; no exact match exists.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: Blueprint references the top-of-page filer identifying number; ShareholderEIN/ShareholderSSN refer to the U.S. shareholder section, not the page-1 filer header — no exact structural match.

tax_year_begin.rationale: No date element for the annual accounting period beginning date appears in the candidate list.

tax_year_end.rationale: No date element for the annual accounting period ending date appears in the candidate list.

schedule_i_subpart_f_income.rationale: Blueprint line 1 is the filer's pro-rata share of total Subpart F income; no single rolled-up total Subpart F amount element exists in the candidate list — the schema splits this across multiple sub-lines (1a–1h).

schedule_i_section_956_amount.rationale: EarningsInvestedInUSPropAmt row label 'Earnings invested in U.S. property' corresponds to Schedule I line 2 (section 956 amount).

schedule_i_section_956a_amount.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to a section 956A amount on Schedule I.

schedule_i_section_1248_dividend.rationale: FactoringIncomeAmt is labeled line 4; however the blueprint describes line 4 as section 1248 dividends, not factoring income — these are different line items on different versions of the form, so this is not a reliable match; returning null is safer.

schedule_i_section_964e_gain.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to a section 964(e) gain amount on Schedule I line 5.

schedule_i_total_inclusions.rationale: No candidate element represents the total Schedule I inclusion amount (sum of lines 1–5).

tested_income.rationale: Schedule I-1 GILTI tested income is not represented in the candidate list, which covers Schedule I elements only.

tested_loss.rationale: Schedule I-1 GILTI tested loss is not represented in the candidate list.

qbai.rationale: Schedule I-1 QBAI element is not present in the candidate list.

tested_interest_expense.rationale: Schedule I-1 tested interest expense element is not present in the candidate list.

tested_interest_income.rationale: Schedule I-1 tested interest income element is not present in the candidate list.

net_deemed_tangible_return.rationale: Schedule I-1 net deemed tangible income return element is not present in the candidate list.

gilti_inclusion.rationale: Schedule I-1 GILTI inclusion amount element is not present in the candidate list.
